standard_prerequisites.name: K-injective restriction
standard_prerequisites.use: g_n^{-1} of a K-injective complex is K-injective on the component.

standard_prerequisites.name: Levelwise direct image
standard_prerequisites.use: The levelwise identity (g'_n)^{-1}h_{total,*} = h_{n,*}g_n^{-1} on sheaves underlying the derived statement.

core_obligations: Statement (lines 1352-1357): with notation and hypotheses of the morphism-of-simplicial-sites lemma, for K in D(C_total) one has (g'_n)^{-1} Rh_{total,*} K = Rh_{n,*} g_n^{-1} K.

Representative choice (proof lines 1359-1364): take a K-injective complex I^bullet on C_total representing K; then g_n^{-1}K is represented by g_n^{-1}I^bullet = I_n^bullet, which is K-injective by the restriction lemma, so g_n^{-1} commutes with the derived direct image.

Levelwise identity (lines 1364-1369): on these representatives (g'_n)^{-1}h_{total,*}I^bullet = h_{n,*}g_n^{-1}I_n^bullet by the levelwise identity of the morphism-of-simplicial-sites lemma, which gives the desired equality in the derived category.
proof_roadmap: Choose a K-injective representative and preserve it under restriction.
Apply the levelwise identity of direct images on the representatives.
Read off the derived base change isomorphism.
difficulty_reason: Base-change lemma (statement 1352-1357, proof 1359-1369): the abelian-site base change for direct images along a morphism of simplicial sites - the proof picks a K-injective representative (preserved by restriction via the in-source lemma, making derived pushforward computable termwise) and applies the levelwise direct-image identity; both steps executed in-span.
